components.name: Grouped Role Navigation
components.description: Desktop shows all role-filtered destinations in light groups; mobile provides the same links in a keyboard-operable native disclosure.
components.css: .desktop-nav { background: #f0f3f3; } .app-nav__link.is-current, .mobile-nav__link.is-current { color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-wash); font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action on a task surface.
components.css: .button--primary { min-height: 2.65rem; background: var(--accent); color: #fff; } .button--primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); } .button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 42%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Labeled Search Field
components.description: A visibly labeled, keyboard-accessible search field for the primary staff task.
components.html: <label for="student-search">Student name, number, or LRN</label><input id="student-search" name="search" type="search">
components.css: input:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio]), select, textarea { min-height: 2.65rem; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 0.5rem; } input:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus { border-color: var(--accent); outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 19%, transparent); }

components.name: Workspace Panel
components.description: A compact light surface groups related forms, review context, or student data without decorative metrics.

narrative.overview: ARKTIESIIS is a centralized school records system. Staff pages make student lookup, enrollment, and document review primary; students use a secondary self-service view. The layout uses a light grouped desktop sidebar, a native mobile disclosure, compact neutral work surfaces, and restrained crimson for actions and current state. The same system covers public entry, authentication, records, finance, documents, teacher grade submission, administration, and account settings.
keyCharacteristics: The official seal, institution name, and Lucena Branch stay visible in the shared masthead.
Staff can find records and reach enrollment, document, grade, schedule, and setup tasks without a horizontal navigation strip.
The student dashboard begins with current-term context, a document-status action, and today's classes.
Compact typography and neutral surfaces support long forms, student lists, review histories, and finance ledgers.

rules.name: The Record-First Rule
rules.body: Lead staff work with student search and put enrollment and document status on the same record path.

rules.name: The One Crimson Signal Rule
rules.body: Use school crimson for primary actions, focus, current destinations, and errors; keep inactive surfaces neutral.

rules.name: The Fit-the-Task Rule
rules.body: Use compact bordered surfaces for related work and avoid generic KPI strips, oversized hero panels, and repeated card directories.

dos: Preserve the official school seal and school name.
Preserve routes, form names, CSRF fields, EJS escaping, and server-side role checks.
Keep missing, processing, review, verified, rejected, disabled, and error states readable without color alone.
Keep layouts usable at 320px and honor reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Do not invent live queue counts, school policy, document authenticity claims, or spreadsheet compatibility.
Do not add external fonts, decorative grids, unnecessary motion, or oversized metric cards.
Do not hide a role destination without an accessible path to it.
Do not change backend permissions to make an interface appear available.
